about.title: Ojai Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When someone dies because another person or business was careless, California allows certain family members to bring a civil wrongful death claim. In Ojai, home to about 7,600 people in Ventura County, that loss ripples through a small community. The public record for 2025 shows 32 injury collisions and 42 people hurt on local roads, with no traffic deaths that year. Even so, fatal harm reaches families here in other ways: a crash on Rt 150 or Ojai Avenue, a fall on poorly kept property, a medical error, or a defective product. The claim belongs first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, and then to certain dependents or heirs. It can seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Most families have two years from the date of death to file, and less when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We match you, for free, with an independent attorney who takes these cases on contingency.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can explain where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Attention to the two-year clock
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county or state agency may be responsible. Reaching out early protects that timeline.

items.title: Separate from any criminal case
items.desc: A wrongful death claim is a civil action; it moves forward whether or not prosecutors bring charges. Attorneys in our network handle it on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Ojai recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death claims don't happen here?
items.answer: No. Traffic is only one source of these claims, and a single year's count does not tell the whole story. Ojai families also lose loved ones to unsafe premises, medical negligence, defective products and workplace incidents, all of which can support a civil claim. And a fatal crash on a corridor like Rt 150 or Grand Avenue can occur in any year regardless of past totals.

items.question: What can my family actually recover in a California wrongful death case?
items.answer: The law allows recovery of funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would likely have provided over their lifetime, and the loss of their love, companionship, care and guidance. The exact mix depends on your relationship to the person and the circumstances. No one can promise a particular result, but an attorney can walk you through what applies to your situation.

items.question: Do I have to wait for a police investigation or criminal trial to finish?
items.answer: You do not. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action with its own two-year deadline, which keeps running even while a criminal matter is pending. If a government entity is involved, the deadline to give notice is much shorter. That is why many Ventura County families speak with an attorney early, even when other proceedings are still open.
